turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: Customer Experience Team: For the first use of your BreatheSmart 25i: 1. Take the purifier out of the box and remove all protective films. 2. Open the front panel and unwrap the filter inside the unit. 3. Place the purifier along your room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture. 4. Plug it in and press the button to turn it on. 5. Leave it running 24/7 for the best results. You can also use the Alen Air App to monitor air quality and filter life or control the purifier remotely.
